jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits. Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era. We have one product: new physics, at scale. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting. The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on. Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first. We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit. What We're Looking For A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials. Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list. You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently. A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically. Nice to Have Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security. Experience in research or scientific computing environments. Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem. Â How We Work We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. A

There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture. This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no." Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. What You'll Bring Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. jobs.description: iMerit is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing. Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match. What you will do Interpret conversational context and identify what the user really wanted Rate and rank responses against defined quality criteria Compare multiple answers and explain in writing why one wins Verify factual claims using approved research sources Flag tasks that cannot be reliably assessed rather than guessing What you bring: Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in ambiguous cases Solid research skills and attention to detail Excellent reading comprehension Self direction and the discipline to hit deadlines without supervision Good to know Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project. Fully remote and flexible. You choose your hours as long as volume and deadlines are met. Task volume varies with project demand.

jobs.title: (Senior) Collection Merchandiser Shoes (f/m/d)
jobs.description: What you will do: As the (Senior) Collection Merchandiser for the Shoes category, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of the footwear assortment. This role requires a deep understanding of luxury fashion, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to drive innovation while maintaining the brand's identity. You will work closely with the design, product development, sales, marketing, and operations teams to create a cohesive and successful shoe collection that meets the needs of both direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) channels. Assortment Strategy: Develop and implement a long-term assortment strategy for the Shoes category, aligning with the brands product vision and catering to the unique requirements of D2C and B2B channels. Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to inform strategic decision-making. Collection Creation: Lead the seasonal collection creation process for Shoes, working in close partnership with the design and product development teams. Ensure the collection reflects the brand's DNA, resonates with target customers, and meets commercial objectives. Own the range and the line plan and ensure they are constantly updated. Critical Path Management: Own the critical path for the Shoes category, ensuring all key milestones and deadlines are met. Schedule and coordinate all relevant meetings, ensuring appropriate stakeholders are involved and prepared. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns and product stories that enhance the visibility and desirability of the Shoes category. Work with sales teams to gather feedback from wholesale partners and clients, ensuring their needs are reflected in the assortment. Foster strong communication and collaboration across departments to achieve common goals. Partner with operations to ensure smooth product delivery and availability across all channels. Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze the performance of the Shoes category, identifying opportunities for growth and areas for improvement. What you will bring: Proven experience (4-5 years) in a merchandising or product management role within the luxury fashion industry, ideally with a focus on footwear. Strong understanding of the luxury market, including D2C and B2B dynamics. Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and meet tight deadlines. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across departments. Passion for luxury fashion, design, and craftsmanship. What we offer: A bright and spacious design office in the heart of Berlin embodying our brand values and focusing on employee well-being. A unique chance to shape our company’s future and build a global brand, all within a motivating, international work environment with employees of 14+ nationalities. A high level of responsibility, creative freedom, and the opportunity to bring your originality, ideas, and independence to life. Once-per-season gift voucher, to be used on Aeyde footwear and accessories. Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership, Berlin Public Transport pass or German lessons for international employees. 30 days of holidays. Flexible hybrid working model subject to team specifications. Regular team events include our Christmas and Summer Party as well as extraordinary monthly team lunches. Relocation assistance available including visa support. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) KI & Automatisierung Stuttgart
jobs.description: Wir suchen Bei HWS verbinden wir Wirtschaftsprüfung und Steuerberatung mit dem Anspruch, mittelständische Unternehmen nicht nur fachlich exzellent, sondern auch zukunftsfähig zu begleiten. Dafür entwickeln wir eine eigene KI-Plattform mit spezialisierten KI-Agenten und Skills, die unsere Teams im Kanzleialltag konkret unterstützen – etwa bei der Aufbereitung von Daten, der Qualitätssicherung, der Recherche und der Erstellung strukturierter Arbeitsergebnisse. Festanstellung / Vollzeit / Erfurt oder Leipzig, Hybrid / Start: ASAP Du möchtest Abschlüsse nicht nur erstellen, sondern Accounting-Prozesse in einem internationalen Softwareunternehmen aktiv mitgestalten? Als Senior Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) übernimmst du Verantwortung für unsere Finanzprozesse und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Abschlüsse zuverlässig, transparent und aussagekräftig sind. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Director Finance & Legal zusammen und entwickelst unsere Prozesse Schritt für Schritt weiter. Cuculus entwickelt Softwarelösungen für Energieversorger weltweit. Dich erwartet ein internationales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung – und der Möglichkeit, Dinge wirklich voranzubringen. Deine Aufgaben Abschlüsse: Du erstellst eigenständig Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB und IFRS – dabei stellst du die Qualität und Vollständigkeit unserer Finanzdaten sicher. Bewertungen & Abgrenzungen: Du bewertest Rückstellungen und Vorräte und stellst periodengerechte Abgrenzungen sicher. Steuern: Du bereitest Steuererklärungen vor, betreust Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen und begleitest Betriebsprüfungen. Kontenabstimmung & Audits: Du stimmst Haupt- und Nebenbücher ab und arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Auditor:innen zusammen. Laufende Buchhaltung: Du verantwortest die laufende Buchhaltung mit und sorgst für die korrekte Erfassung, Prüfung und Abstimmung der Geschäftsvorfälle – von Debitoren und Kreditoren bis zum Hauptbuch. KI & Automatisierung: Du bringst Ideen ein, wie wir Routinearbeit reduzieren und Finance-Prozesse optimieren können – und setzt dies gemeinsam mit dem Director Finance & Legal um. Dein Profil Accounting-Erfahrung: Mindestens fünf Jahre im Accounting mit Abschlussverantwortung. Qualifikation: Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK), kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder vergleichbar. Erfahrung aus einer Steuerberatung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. HGB & IFRS: Fundierte Kenntnisse, die du in der Praxis sicher anwendest. Systeme: Excel gehört für dich zum Arbeitsalltag. Sage 100 und Candis sind ein Plus. KI-Affinität: Du nutzt KI-Tools bereits im Arbeitsalltag - oder hast Lust, damit anzufangen. Deutsch & Englisch: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch mit Steuerberatung, Behörden und Auditor:innen. Englisch ist bei uns Voraussetzung – du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld und stimmst dich auch dort sicher ab. Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, setzt selbstständig Prioritäten und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Weiterentwicklung : Du möchtest nicht einfach bestehende Prozesse verwalten, sondern deinen Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mitgestalten. Warum wir? Wir glauben, dass gute Arbeit Verantwortung, Vertrauen und den nötigen Freiraum braucht. Deshalb bekommst du bei Cuculus die Möglichkeit, deine Expertise einzubringen und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Finance-Bereichs aktiv mitzugestalten. Hybrides Arbeiten: Mit regelmäßiger Office-Präsenz (2–3 Tage/Woche in Erfurt oder Leipzig) Flexibilität : Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Workation-Option (bis zu 4 Wochen/Jahr) Mobilität : 50 % Zuschuss fürs Deutschlandticket & Bike Leasing Sicherheit : Betriebliche Altersvorsorge & vermögenswirksame Leistungen Kultur : Kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Feedbackkultur & echtes Vertrauen Onboarding : Damit du gut ankommst, bekommst du bei uns einen Einarbeitungsplan und einen Buddy an deine Seite. Office-Leben: Wir kommen gern in unseren Offices zusammen, sei es auf einen Kaffee, ein gemeinsames Mittagessen oder ein spontanes Afterwork. Impact : Arbeit mit Sinn - mit unserer Software unterstützt du indirekt Energieversorger weltweit dabei, die Transformation des Energiemarkts voranzutreiben. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior GenAI Solution Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: What you can expect from us We are a technical, implementation-oriented spin-off of a global management consultancy. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies, which we advise on issues in the areas of analytics, big data and machine learning. Within the group, we take on the development of individual and data-driven solutions in order to transform our clients into AI-powered companies. We offer an international working environment with agile teams and creative startup methods as well as above-average remuneration and numerous additional benefits. With our offices in Hamburg, Munich and Düsseldorf and our hub locations in all other major German cities (Berlin, Frankfurt and Stuttgart), we ensure that all colleagues are integrated into our team of experts across Germany. Your role as a Senior GenAI Solution Engineer: End-to-End Development: You drive AI solutions across the full lifecycle - from rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept to deployment in scalable, highly available production environments. AI Services Engineering: You build robust backend services in Python that seamlessly integrate state-of-the-art LLMs and perform reliably under production load. Autonomous Agent Architecture: You design and implement intelligent agent systems that automate real-world workflows through tool calling and memory management, operating safely within defined guardrails. Agentic SDLC: You integrate AI agents into the development lifecycle - from AI-assisted coding and code reviews to automated testing and intelligent documentation - enhancing efficiency across the entire software development process through agentic tools. Ensuring Software Excellence: You take ownership of code quality by applying clean architecture principles, implementing automated testing, and establishing efficient CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth and reliable deployments. Evaluation & Monitoring: You implement frameworks to measure the performance of GenAI solutions (e.g., accuracy, latency, cost) and ensure continuous optimization. Consulting: You work directly with clients - facilitating workshops and acting as a sparring partner for business and management stakeholders. You translate complex AI concepts into tangible business impact and co-create the right solutions. Technology Sparring: You assess technical feasibility and advise stakeholders on how to turn innovative ideas into sustainable, production-ready products. Who you are Excellent Python Skills (Production-Ready): You have strong expertise in API development (e.g., FastAPI, Pydantic), containerization (Docker), testing (unit and integration), as well as Git and CI/CD - well beyond notebook-based scripting. Rapid Prototyping: Ability to quickly build and visualize demos and proof-of-concepts. Strong Architectural Understanding: You apply SOLID principles, Clean Architecture, dependency injection, and async/concurrency patterns in a structured way, and leverage ORMs (e.g., SQLAlchemy) for clean and efficient database interactions. Hands-on Experience with Multimodal LLM APIs: Proficient in working with leading models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock). Advanced GenAI Engineering: Strong command of prompt engineering, structured outputs (JSON), and tool/function calling. RAG Expertise (End-to-End): Experience in building full pipelines - from embeddings and vector databases (e.g., pgvector) to advanced retrieval, re-ranking, and evaluation. Agent Development: Experience in designing and orchestrating autonomous systems (e.g., with Pydantic AI), including memory management and guardrails. Consulting Skills: Experience working directly with clients. You are able to facilitate workshops, present results, and confidently navigate complex stakeholder environments. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: What you can expect from us Eraneos supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close. For us, the work doesn't stop at the concept stage, and it doesn't start only once the spec is finished: an initiative stays in one pair of hands from the first idea to the running system. We work in a results-driven way rather than following the classic consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies. You help decide what gets built, not just how. We always work with the latest models and tools to succeed with the client. There's no prescribed stack — instead, we pick the right tool for each task. You design technical solutions from the first idea through to production deployment, working closely with decision-makers on both the client and management side. What to expect: You own the architecture and technical implementation of the AI solution end to end — from strategy through to production You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real enterprise environments Agentic coding tools are your everyday toolkit: you use them to develop solutions, speed up reviews, and build deployment pipelines You're involved from the very first idea, not just once the spec is finished — growing deeper into the strategic and business side along the way You stay accountable until the end: you don't hand things off, you see the solution through until it's running and delivering impact You represent your technical decisions directly at executive level and lead these conversations yourself, without going through an intermediary layer Who you are You stand behind the whole outcome, not just one part of it. You stick with it until the solution is running in production and delivering impact, and you share in the responsibility for that — a founder and product mindset rather than simply executing tasks You build hands-on, at the highest level — and you think beyond the code. From an engineering perspective, that means you've already taken LLM-based systems into production and understand the business rationale behind them, not just the architecture You're convincing at executive level. You've already owned and defended technical decisions directly in front of top management. You bring this with you — we won't be developing you into it Proven experience bringing LLM-based systems into production — ideally as a Forward-Deployed or Founding Engineer Excellent, production-grade Python skills (e.g. FastAPI , containers, Git, CI/CD) and a deep understanding of agentic architectures, retrieval methods, and function calling You use agentic coding tools as a core part of your toolkit, not as a gimmick — including building deployment pipelines An appetite for picking up where classic engineering roles leave off, and for growing deeper into the strategic side Ideally, experience in one of our core industries — Financial Services, Transportation & Logistics, Energy & Utilities, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Public Sector, Automotive, or Defence . More important than the specific industry is that you quickly get up to speed in a new, often regulated environment German (at least C1) and business-fluent English Willingness to work regularly on-site at client locations A completed degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, data science, business informatics, or a comparable field ( Bachelor's or higher) Who we are Shape the future with AI by working on diverse and impactful projects at the intersection of strategy, technology, and business. Work flexibly in a way that suits your life – with hybrid working models, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home. Enjoy an open, collaborative culture with flat hierarchies, an international team, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge and support one another

jobs.title: Photonics Characterisation Engineer
jobs.description: The role We are looking for a Photonic Characterisation Engineer to join our Photonics team and play a key role in the experimental characterisation of advanced integrated photonic devices. This is a highly hands-on position where you will design and run experiments, operate optical test equipment, analyse measurement data and help turn experimental results into clear engineering insight. Your work will support teams across photonic design, manufacturing and system testing, helping ensure technical decisions are grounded in high-quality, repeatable data. You will work across both die-level and wafer-level characterisation, combining practical laboratory work with Python-based data analysis and experimental automation. Over time, you will take increasing ownership of characterisation activities, from defining test approaches through to delivering results and communicating conclusions to stakeholders. This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys being in the lab, working through difficult experimental problems and moving comfortably between optics, software and data. What you'll be doing Design and execute experiments to characterise integrated photonic devices and structures Operate optical and photonic laboratory equipment across a range of measurement setups Carry out die-level and wafer-level testing Analyse experimental data using Python and relevant scientific computing tools Develop scripts and workflows to automate data collection and analysis Translate experimental requirements into practical, repeatable test methodologies Identify measurement issues, investigate unexpected results and troubleshoot experimental setups Validate data quality before results are used by wider engineering teams Produce clear technical reports, analysis and summaries from experimental work Collaborate closely with photonic design, manufacturing and system testing teams Support the development and improvement of laboratory processes, test methods and automation Take ownership of characterisation tasks and provide realistic timelines for delivery As you develop in the role, you will be expected to work increasingly independently, building new test methods where required and taking experiments from initial planning through execution, analysis and communication of results. What we're looking for An MSc, PhD or equivalent practical experience in Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or a closely related discipline A strong understanding of optics and photonics fundamentals Hands-on experience designing and running experiments Experience working in an optics, photonics or similarly technical laboratory environment Experience analysing real-world experimental data using Python Familiarity with scientific Python libraries such as NumPy, SciPy or pandas A practical understanding of experimental uncertainty, noisy data and measurement quality Strong fault-finding and troubleshooting skills The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team Strong attention to detail and critical thinking Clear written and verbal communication skills The ability to present technical results clearly to different audiences You should be comfortable spending a significant proportion of your time working physically in the laboratory. This is not primarily a theoretical or simulation-focused position. Even better if you have Experience working with photonic wafer-level test systems or probe stations Experience with integrated photonic devices and their characterisation Experience automating experimental setups or measurement equipment using Python Familiarity with optical alignment, calibration and measurement techniques Experience with free-space optics Knowledge of photonic integrated circuit fabrication or semiconductor processes Experience developing reusable experimental or data-analysis tools Previous experience in an R&D or product development environment Experienc

You will, too.</strong></p> <p>Capstone Investment Advisors, LLC (“Capstone”) is a global asset manager, dedicated to exploring alpha opportunities in derivatives and complementary strategies that persist across market cycles. With approximately $12.5 billion of AUM (as of May 1, 2026) and 306 employees, Capstone is headquartered in New York with offices in London, Amsterdam, Stamford, Los Angeles, Boston, Tokyo, Milan, Texas, and Maryland. Since 2004, through strategic insight, market-leading expertise, and advanced technology, we have sought to anticipate and harness the complexities of world markets, creating unique opportunities for our clients, team, and industry.</p> <p>With our sophisticated, global client base, we recognize that our success is deeply connected to real people. For that reason, we take a human approach to everything we do, focusing largely on collaborative performance. Our workflow and process are built around the belief that by sharing ideas, we achieve greater outcomes. This gives you greater access to resources, direct exposure to senior leadership, and new opportunities to experiment and innovate.</p> <p><strong>The Team:</strong></p> <p>Capstone is looking to appoint a Senior Risk Engineer at Senior Vice President level within Risk Technology. jobs.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors. Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs. Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles: Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie. Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders. What you’ll do Design, integrate, and deliver high-performance digital subsystems within mixed-signal ICs, enabling control, calibration, and high-speed data movement in analog-centric environments — owning the flow from RTL to physical implementation and tape-out. Responsibilities Design and verify digital subsystems that interface directly with high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits — including calibration engines, control FSMs, data converters, and multiplexing logic. Contribute to the design of analog components at the digital-analog interface: calibration circuits, DACs/ADCs, comparators, and others. Integrate and customize external IP blocks (e.g., GPIOs, LVDS I/Os, serial interfaces), ensuring compliance with analog signal and timing requirements. Lead the digital implementation flow for mixed-signal blocks: from RTL to synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, timing closure, physical signoff, and tape-out. Collaborate closely with analog, layout, and system teams to co-optimize digital-analog boundaries, resolve cross-domain issues, and ensure robust high-speed performance. Contribute to the development of high-speed serial I/O subsystems — experience in the design and implementation of SerDes blocks is a significant advantage. Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus. Required Skills and Experience Strong experience in digital RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), particularly for mixed-signal systems involving high-speed calibration/control loops, converters, multiplexers, and serial/parallel data paths. Experience with analog IC development environments (Virtuoso or equivalent). Deep understanding of digital-analog integration challenges, including timing closure, noise coupling, clock domain crossing, and analog-aware floorplanning in high-speed environments. Proven ability to drive digital blocks from design through verification, synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, and tape-out, especially in the context of analog or RF ICs. Skilled in integrating and adapting external IPs such as GPIOs, LVDS, SPI/I²C interfaces; experience with high-speed serializers/deserializers (SerDes) is a highly valued plus. Proficient with industry-standard EDA toolchains for both front-end (design/verification) and back-end (physical implementation), with a strong grasp of mixed-signal layout constraints. Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers). Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location. Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays. jobs.title: Senior Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer
jobs.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do As Senior Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer you will own the methodology, planning, and execution of mixed-signal verification for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago's Systems-on-Chip, working across analog, RTL, architecture, and firmware teams to ensure correct integration and drive verification to sign-off. Required Skills and Experience Strong hands-on experience in ASIC or SoC verification. Experience verifying mixed-signal blocks or digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital interfaces. Strong SystemVerilog skills and practical experience with UVM or an equivalent verification methodology. Experience building verification environments and developing tests, assertions, scoreboards, and functional coverage. Good understanding of both digital design fundamentals and basic analog/mixed-signal concepts. Strong debugging skills, including the ability to investigate issues spanning RTL, models, clocks, resets, configuration, and analog behavior. Experience with scripting and automation, preferably Python, Tcl, shell, or similar. Language: English at a proficient level. Responsibilities Own the mixed-signal verification methodology and verification plan for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago SoCs. Build and maintain verification environments at block, subsystem, and SoC level. Develop tests, assertions, checkers, scoreboards, and functional coverage. The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure. Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation. Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity. jobs.title: (Senior) Finance & Accounting Manager (f/m/d) – bunch capital
jobs.description: We are recruiting for this position on behalf of our partner, bunch capital. bunch is building the backbone of private markets, enabling next-generation fund operations through one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows, and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful and ambitious team, this role might be for you. bunch is looking for a (Senior) Finance & Accounting Manager to be the backbone of its day-to-day financial operations. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the intersection of accounting, billing, payroll, and process improvement . You will be responsible for key financial operations, including preparatory accounting (vorbereitende Buchhaltung), spend management, and client invoicing across all bunch entities. We are looking for someone with a strong accounting foundation who has expanded – or would like to further expand – into broader finance topics and take on more responsibility across the finance function. You will gain direct exposure to the full finance function of a fast-growing fintech, report directly to the Head of Finance , and have the opportunity to grow your role within the Finance Team over time. Candidates with appropriate senior-level experience may join at Senior Manager level. From day one, you will play a critical role in strengthening and optimising bunch’s financial operations as the company grows and scales across markets. What You’ll Do Handle all our preparatory accounting (including assigning cost centers and cost units) on both the creditor and debtor side (Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung) and be responsible for exports to our external accountants in all our jurisdictions Own our spend management processes, including weekly invoice review and approval, credit card and employee reimbursement management, and direct debit setup, and make sure we pay our bills on time Run quarterly and annual invoicing across all products and jurisdictions and take the lead on reducing manual effort by working with our analytics and other teams to improve and automate our invoicing setup. You'll also track client payments and flag overdue accounts Support our monthly close by coordinating with external accountants across all jurisdictions and entities, ensuring timely delivery of monthly and annual accounts and that our external partners always have what they need on time Support on our regular tax filings, such as for VAT, across our entities Conduct monthly payroll reviews and serve as the internal point of contact for payroll-related questions — including social security, health insurance, pension contributions, and employee benefits — as well as financial employee policies such as expense reimbursement Support equity financing rounds alongside Legal, Strategy, and FP&A — including due diligence and data room preparation. You'll also pick up one-off banking and insurance needs as they arise What you bring At least 2–4 years of experience in an in-house finance role, reputable consultancy, or completed training as a tax clerk (Steuerfachangestellte/r) or accountant (Bilanzbuchhalter/in). This role has flexibility in its seniority — for more senior candidates beyond 5-6 years experience, we can offer a “Senior Manager” role Mastery of the fundamentals of accounting and familiarity with common tax issues arising in a multi-jurisdictional company Hands-on experience with accounting, billing, and spend management tools (e.g. DATEV, Stripe, Moss, Spendesk) or similar systems Highly organised and reliable, with a track record of owning recurring processes independently Genuine interest in process optimisation and automation — you notice inefficiencies and want to fix them Strong attention to detail and quality orientation A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and comfort handling new responsibilities High level of ownership, reliability, and flexibility SaaS and/or fund industry exper

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description: TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM. Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature. Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Introduction At a glance Location & work model : Berlin, hybrid Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester ( KubeVirt ), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must Why this role is special Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. Your first 90 days You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next. Your mission Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard Plan capacity, performance and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations Your profile Must-haves: Kubernetes in production – built, not just used : you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm , RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role Lived SRE practice : SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call Hands-on experience with GitOps or comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): Harvester, KubeVirt , vSphere/ ESXi , OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN) Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler ) and capacity/cost planning Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs German language skills Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've act

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer - ClickPipes Platform
jobs.description: About the Team The ClickPipes Platform plays a critical role in driving the growth of our company and ensuring the success of our clients by seamlessly onboarding and integrating data from diverse data sources into ClickHouse. Working at a petabyte scale and in high-velocity environments, this role offers an exceptional opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, operate with significant autonomy, and make a measurable impact. Working on ClickPipes offers the opportunity to operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy, tackle ambiguous problems, and deliver features that are used by some of the most data-intensive companies in the world. You can find some of the teams recent work highlighted in our blog: Flexible Scaling and Monitoring in ClickPipes MySQL CDC Connector for ClickPipes The Evolution of ClickPipes As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you’ll design and build complex, data-heavy user interfaces and own customer-facing workflows end-to-end. While this role has a strong frontend focus, engineers are expected to work comfortably across the whole stack, collaborating on backend services, APIs, and system integrations as needed. We’re looking for T-shaped engineers who bring deep frontend expertise while remaining pragmatic and effective beyond UI tasks. What will you do? Build scalable UI systems that handle large datasets, async operations, and real-time state changes Own features end-to-end, from initial design through production launch and long-term maintenance Collaborate closely with product, design, and other engineering teams to deliver new features Partner on API design and system contracts Participate in an on-call rotation to support ClickPipes in production, helping diagnose incidents, and mitigate issues Take ownership of production quality, including monitoring, debugging, performance tuning, and reliability improvements What you will bring: 5+ years of experience building and shipping production full-stack applications In-depth knowledge of web fundamentals (HTML/CSS, JavaScript, DOM, HTTP) Solid experience in designing and building applications with React and TypeScript Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) as part of a CI/CD workflow Practical knowledge of backend systems, REST and/or GraphQL APIs, and service-oriented architecture Great communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a distributed, async-friendly team Nice to have: Familiarity with Go, Node, or other server-side languages Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform Experience working on data-intensive products or platforms at scale Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology at the intersection of data engineering and cloud-native infrastructure. Be part of a high-visibility team integral to the company’s success. Operate with autonomy, ownership, and the ability to drive meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving space. jobs.title: Security Specialist - EMEA (location flexible)
jobs.description: As ClickHouse moves further into financial services, healthcare, telco, and the public sector across EMEA, more of our deals now turn on a specific set of questions: where the data lives, who can reach it, how it's encrypted, and what the auditor needs to see. We're looking for a Security Specialist to own those conversations, a specialist overlay within our EMEA Solutions Architecture team , brought in when security, data residency, or regulatory compliance conversations come up on a deal. Our ideal candidate comes from inside the data industry - and pairs deep security expertise with real data architecture depth . You'll be the credible technical voice in front of CISOs and security architects, and the internal authority our field relies on for answers. What You'll Be Doing Act as the security overlay on EMEA opportunities supporting conversations related to security, privacy, or compliance, engaging customers and prospects alongside the account Solutions Architect and Account Executive, discussing our various deployment models, BYOC architectures and all related security questions. Lead security conversations with CISOs, security architects, and GRC teams , translating ClickHouse architecture into the controls frameworks they recognize. Design and validate secure ClickHouse Cloud and BYOC deployment patterns network isolation, private connectivity, encryption, customer-managed keys, identity federation, and granular access control. Run threat modelling and architecture reviews with customer security teams, and own the security workstream through POC and production readiness. Be the field's authority on our compliance posture — SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR and EU data residency, HIPAA, PCI DSS , and the European regulatory picture including DORA and NIS2. Raise the quality and speed of security questionnaires, RFP security sections, DPIAs, and third-party risk reviews , building the reusable answer library as you go. Build the security playbook for EMEA Solutions Architecture and enable SAs and AEs so routine security questions stay with the account team. What You Bring Significant customer-facing technical experience at a data platform, analytics, streaming, or database company — you understand data architecture, not just security controls. Demonstrable depth in cloud and data security : IAM, key management and cryptography, network isolation, secure multi-tenancy, threat modelling, and audit. Working command of the frameworks that gate enterprise data deals — SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS — and comfort with EU regulation. Credibility with security buyers. You've held your own in front of a CISO and know the difference between answering the question and getting through the meeting. Overlay instincts and clear writing — comfortable working through others, prioritizing across a region, and producing artefacts that survive an auditor's reading. Bonus Points For Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or CISM . Hands-on security architecture experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure . Experience in regulated industries — financial services, healthcare, telco, or the public sector. Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel – Contracts (German speaker)
jobs.description: Could your legal expertise help build the contractual foundations of Europe’s next financial management platform? At Pennylane, we believe legal should be more than a safeguard. It should be a business enabler. Our ambition is to equip millions of small and medium-sized businesses across Europe with a complete, high-performing financial management platform. As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team. Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners. Reporting to the Lead Legal Counsel, Contracts , you will work closely with our Sales, Partnerships, Security, Finance and Product teams. This is a hands-on role where legal rigor, creativity and business pragmatism are equally valued. 🌍 What is Pennylane? Pennylane is one of France’s most dynamic fintech companies, currently expanding rapidly across Europe. In just six years, we have managed to: 💻 Establish ourselves in the market as an innovative provider of accounting and financial management software 💰 Raise a total of €400 million from renowned investors, including Sequoia, Silicon Valley’s leading venture capital firm, known for backing Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal, and many others in their early days 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 co-founders to a team of 1,000 employees, with an average Glassdoor rating of 4.9/5 and 94% of reviewers saying they would recommend Pennylane to their friends and family 🌍 Build an international team made up of employees from 25 different countries, with a truly flexible remote-working culture 🚀 More than 900,000 small and medium-sized businesses and over 6,000 accounting firms in France already use Pennylane! 🎯 Your role You will act as a trusted legal partner for teams across Pennylane, managing a broad range of commercial and operational agreements from drafting through to signature and post-signature follow-up. You will also help make our contracting processes more efficient and scalable, contributing to the tools, templates, playbooks and legal culture that support Pennylane’s growth. 📋 Your responsibilities International contracts Draft and negotiate purchase orders and related agreements with partner firms, primarily outside France, with a current focus on Germany. Manage contracts with strategic international suppliers. Maintain and improve templates in line with regulatory, product and business developments. Work with Sales and Partnerships to streamline the contracting process. Customer, reseller and integrator agreements Improve customer terms and conditions for SME customers across France and Europe. Support Sales with the contracting process and automated quotations. Review and negotiate agreements with Pennylane integrators and resellers. Anticipate the contractual impact of key regulations, including e-invoicing, payment services and the EU AI Act. Contribute to contract templates and playbooks. Legal operations and collaboration Structure and improve internal contracting processes to increase efficiency and scalability. Optimize our contract management tools, including Tomorro, Pivot and Notion. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, low-value tasks, including through AI. Provide clear, pragmatic advice to Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Security and Product teams. Train non-legal teams and help build a strong legal culture across Pennylane. 🙋 The profile we are looking for You are a qualified lawyer or legal counsel with extensive experience in contract law, gained in a law firm, particularly in IP/IT, technology or SaaS, and/or in a fast-growing tech company. You are fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Franch and German. You have strong expertise in B2B SaaS agreements , including IP, indemnification, liability caps

This role makes that system work. jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel – Contracts (German speaker)
jobs.description: Could your legal expertise help build the contractual foundations of Europe’s next financial management platform? At Pennylane, we believe legal should be more than a safeguard. It should be a business enabler. Our ambition is to equip millions of small and medium-sized businesses across Europe with a complete, high-performing financial management platform. As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team. Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners. Reporting to the Lead Legal Counsel, Contracts , you will work closely with our Sales, Partnerships, Security, Finance and Product teams. This is a hands-on role where legal rigor, creativity and business pragmatism are equally valued. 🌍 What is Pennylane? Pennylane is one of France’s most dynamic fintech companies, currently expanding rapidly across Europe. In just six years, we have managed to: 💻 Establish ourselves in the market as an innovative provider of accounting and financial management software 💰 Raise a total of €400 million from renowned investors, including Sequoia, Silicon Valley’s leading venture capital firm, known for backing Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal, and many others in their early days 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 co-founders to a team of 1,000 employees, with an average Glassdoor rating of 4.9/5 and 94% of reviewers saying they would recommend Pennylane to their friends and family 🌍 Build an international team made up of employees from 25 different countries, with a truly flexible remote-working culture 🚀 More than 900,000 small and medium-sized businesses and over 6,000 accounting firms in France already use Pennylane! 🎯 Your role You will act as a trusted legal partner for teams across Pennylane, managing a broad range of commercial and operational agreements from drafting through to signature and post-signature follow-up. You will also help make our contracting processes more efficient and scalable, contributing to the tools, templates, playbooks and legal culture that support Pennylane’s growth. 📋 Your responsibilities International contracts Draft and negotiate purchase orders and related agreements with partner firms, primarily outside France, with a current focus on Germany. Manage contracts with strategic international suppliers. Maintain and improve templates in line with regulatory, product and business developments. Work with Sales and Partnerships to streamline the contracting process. Customer, reseller and integrator agreements Improve customer terms and conditions for SME customers across France and Europe. Support Sales with the contracting process and automated quotations. Review and negotiate agreements with Pennylane integrators and resellers. Anticipate the contractual impact of key regulations, including e-invoicing, payment services and the EU AI Act. Contribute to contract templates and playbooks. Legal operations and collaboration Structure and improve internal contracting processes to increase efficiency and scalability. Optimize our contract management tools, including Tomorro, Pivot and Notion. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, low-value tasks, including through AI. Provide clear, pragmatic advice to Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Security and Product teams. Train non-legal teams and help build a strong legal culture across Pennylane. 🙋 The profile we are looking for You are a qualified lawyer or legal counsel with extensive experience in contract law, gained in a law firm, particularly in IP/IT, technology or SaaS, and/or in a fast-growing tech company. You are fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Franch and German. You have strong expertise in B2B SaaS agreements , including IP, indemnification, liability caps

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel – Contracts (German speaker)
jobs.description: Could your legal expertise help build the contractual foundations of Europe’s next financial management platform? At Pennylane, we believe legal should be more than a safeguard. It should be a business enabler. Our ambition is to equip millions of small and medium-sized businesses across Europe with a complete, high-performing financial management platform. As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team. Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners. Reporting to the Lead Legal Counsel, Contracts , you will work closely with our Sales, Partnerships, Security, Finance and Product teams. This is a hands-on role where legal rigor, creativity and business pragmatism are equally valued. 🌍 What is Pennylane? Pennylane is one of France’s most dynamic fintech companies, currently expanding rapidly across Europe. In just six years, we have managed to: 💻 Establish ourselves in the market as an innovative provider of accounting and financial management software 💰 Raise a total of €400 million from renowned investors, including Sequoia, Silicon Valley’s leading venture capital firm, known for backing Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal, and many others in their early days 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 co-founders to a team of 1,000 employees, with an average Glassdoor rating of 4.9/5 and 94% of reviewers saying they would recommend Pennylane to their friends and family 🌍 Build an international team made up of employees from 25 different countries, with a truly flexible remote-working culture 🚀 More than 900,000 small and medium-sized businesses and over 6,000 accounting firms in France already use Pennylane! 🎯 Your role You will act as a trusted legal partner for teams across Pennylane, managing a broad range of commercial and operational agreements from drafting through to signature and post-signature follow-up. You will also help make our contracting processes more efficient and scalable, contributing to the tools, templates, playbooks and legal culture that support Pennylane’s growth. 📋 Your responsibilities International contracts Draft and negotiate purchase orders and related agreements with partner firms, primarily outside France, with a current focus on Germany. Manage contracts with strategic international suppliers. Maintain and improve templates in line with regulatory, product and business developments. Work with Sales and Partnerships to streamline the contracting process. Customer, reseller and integrator agreements Improve customer terms and conditions for SME customers across France and Europe. Support Sales with the contracting process and automated quotations. Review and negotiate agreements with Pennylane integrators and resellers. Anticipate the contractual impact of key regulations, including e-invoicing, payment services and the EU AI Act. Contribute to contract templates and playbooks. Legal operations and collaboration Structure and improve internal contracting processes to increase efficiency and scalability. Optimize our contract management tools, including Tomorro, Pivot and Notion. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, low-value tasks, including through AI. Provide clear, pragmatic advice to Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Security and Product teams. Train non-legal teams and help build a strong legal culture across Pennylane. 🙋 The profile we are looking for You are a qualified lawyer or legal counsel with extensive experience in contract law, gained in a law firm, particularly in IP/IT, technology or SaaS, and/or in a fast-growing tech company. You are fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Franch and German. You have strong expertise in B2B SaaS agreements , including IP, indemnification, liability caps

jobs.title: Workplace & Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pennylane poursuit son développement tout en maintenant un modèle remote-friendly fort. Notre siège à Paris est le point de ralliement de nos équipes (basées en Île-de-France, en région et à l'international) lors des onboardings et des rassemblements d'entreprise. En tant que People Experience Specialist, tu es le/la référent(e) opérationnel(le) de ton périmètre. Centré(e) sur les besoins des équipes internes, tu analyses les problématiques de A à Z, optimises nos processus de manière structurée et pilotes en autonomie la qualité de vie au siège, le parcours d'intégration ainsi que les initiatives RSE et Hubs internationaux. Tes objectifs et ton impact Pour les collaborateurs : Garantir une expérience d'intégration claire, fluide et personnalisée pour 50 à 90 arrivants par mois, tout en assurant au HQ un cadre de travail performant et accueillant. Pour l'équipe PeX & le Management : Piloter votre périmètre en autonomie, gérer les situations complexes avec pragmatisme et proposer des améliorations basées sur la donnée et les retours utilisateurs. Pour l'organisation : Améliorer continuellement nos méthodes de travail via la digitalisation et l'usage de l'IA, tout en participant à la vision future de nos besoins en terme de bureaux. Tes missions au quotidien Office, Workplace & HQ (30 %) : Piloter en autonomie le fonctionnement quotidien du siège parisien, garantir un cadre de travail performant et accueillant pour les équipes, et gérer la relation ainsi que la qualité de service des prestataires externes. Sécurité, Santé & Dialogue Social (CSSCT / CSE) (30 %): Tu sièges à la commission SSCT et travailles en étroite collaboration avec le CSE en tant que référent(e) interne pour le suivi du DUERP, l'élaboration du Papripact et la mise en œuvre des actions de prévention et de santé au travail. Onboarding & Parcours d'intégration (20 %) : Garantir une expérience d'accueil sur site claire, fluide et personnalisée

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders)
jobs.description: Deine Rolle bei uns Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung. In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte. Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert. Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen. Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen. Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung. Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: What's it all about? The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity. At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions. Your impact As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts. The role Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team What we need from you You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required) Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus You communicate clearly and confidently in English What we offer Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro City center office location including home office option EGYM Wellpass membership support Educational budget for every employee Team events, summer & winter parties Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team Sounds good to you?
