jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. jobs.title: Shopify Manager (m/w/d) - Conversion, Funnel & Shop-Entwicklung
jobs.description: Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern einen Shop wirklich verantworten? Bei NEOLYMP übernimmst du unseren Shopify-Shop in einer Phase, in der jede Optimierung sichtbar auf Umsatz und Wachstum wirkt – von der Landingpage bis zur letzten Zeile Liquid. Wer wir sind NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen. Warum diese Rolle: Echte Verantwortung: Der Shop ist dein Bereich. Du entscheidest, was gebaut und getestet wird – und setzt es selbst um. Sichtbarer Impact: Conversion Rate, Bestellwert, Ladezeit – alles, was du bewegst, siehst du direkt in den Zahlen. Funnel-Fokus: Landingpages und Funnel-Seiten sind bei uns kein Nebenthema, sondern der Kern unseres Wachstums. Kein Silo: Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen und bist die Schnittstelle, die Ideen in fertige Seiten übersetzt. Benefits: Vollständige Remote-Arbeit mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten. “Spenditcard” mit 50€ steuerfreier Sachprämie monatlich zur freien Verfügung. Regelmäßige Team-Events und ein motiviertes, modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke. Aufbau und Verantwortung eines eigenen Bereichs mit sehr viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Kurze Entscheidungswege und starke Startup-Kultur mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten auf dich zugeschnitten. Aufgaben Funnel & Conversion Du konzipierst und baust Landingpages und Funnel-Seiten, die Kund:innen intuitiv zur Bestellung führen. Du optimierst unsere Produktseiten verkaufspsychologisch – von Struktur und Aufbau bis ins Detail. Du baust Upsells, Bundles und Trust-Elemente ein, die den durchschnittlichen Bestellwert messbar steigern. Testing & Analyse Du planst A/B-Tests, wertest sie aus und leitest daraus die nächsten Maßnahmen ab. Du analysierst Conversion Rate, Customer Journey und Bestellwert laufend und erkennst, wo Potenzial liegt. Technik & Performance Du entwickelst unser Shopify-Theme eigenständig weiter und setzt neue Features direkt im Code um. Du hältst den Shop technisch auf Top-Niveau – Ladezeiten, Performance und SEO inklusive. Qualifikation Das ist uns wichtig Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Shopify und ein sicheres Verständnis von Theme-Architektur und Liquid. Solide HTML- und CSS-Kenntnisse, um Features eigenständig umzusetzen. Ein starkes Marketing- und Conversion-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie verkaufsstarke Produktseiten, Landingpages und Customer Journeys aufgebaut sind. Erfahrung mit CRO, A/B-Testing und Heat Maps. Eine datengetriebene Arbeitsweise – du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen, nicht aus dem Bauch. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du setzt Dinge um, statt auf Zuarbeit zu warten. Das zählt für uns am meisten Lust und Motivation, dich weiterzuentwickeln und mit der Rolle zu wachsen. Die nächsten Meilensteine erreichen wir gemeinsam – dafür ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil. Nice to have Erfahrung mit Klaviyo oder vergleichbaren E-Mail-Marketing-Tools (Newsletter-Kampagnen, automatisierte Flows). So arbeiten wir: Remote first: Du arbeitest vollständig remote mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten – wir messen Ergebnisse, nicht Anwesenheit. Im Team: Du bist Teil eines hochmotivierten Teams aus Marketing, Performance und E-Commerce, das gemeinsam an einem Ziel zieht. Kurze Wege: Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Feedback ist direkt, und gute Ideen werden umgesetzt, nicht vertagt. Startup-Kultur mit Substanz: Wir sind seit 2018 am Markt, wachsen profitabel und haben trotzdem den Drive der ersten Stunde behalten.Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – und darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Kontakt: Josephine Steuer Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt uns stärker macht. Deshalb heißen wir alle Bewerbenden willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung. Bei uns gibt es keinen Dressco

jobs.title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
jobs.description: Abstract Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting. Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception. As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting. These tasks interest you Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences. Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations. Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections. Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility. Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results. That makes you stand out You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field. You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch . You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry , or multi-view vision . Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial. Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level) . Knowledge of German is desirable but not required. Consent-Raten, ITP-Restriktionen und Adblocker haben die klassische Messung ausgehöhlt, und was übrig bleibt, wird dennoch als Entscheidungsgrundlage herangezogen. Bei unseren Kunden, B2B Hidden Champions aus Manufacturing, Industrial Goods und Wholesale, kommt dazu: Eine Buying Journey über neun Monate mit sechs Beteiligten lässt sich nicht mit Formular-Submits abbilden. Von Rohdaten zur Aussage: GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Matomo.Otterly.AI. Du arbeitest jenseits der GA4-Oberfläche und lieferst drei belastbare Aussagen statt dreißig Charts – inklusive der Unsicherheit, die du benennst. Reportinglogik definieren: Du legst Metriken, Granularität und Reportingrhythmus fest und spezifizierst die Dashboards. Den Build machst du gemeinsam mit Data & BI (Power BI, Looker Studio). Lead-Qualität statt Lead-Menge: Rückkopplung ins CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), Offline-Conversion-Import, Verknüpfung von Marketing-Daten mit dem, was im Vertrieb tatsächlich passiert. Das ist der Punkt, an dem B2B-Analytics anfängt, relevant zu werden. Datenschutzkonform messen: Du verantwortest die technische Umsetzung – CMP-Setups (Usercentrics, Cookiebot, OneTrust), Consent-Signale, Datenminimierung – in Abstimmung mit Rechtsabteilung bzw. Datenschutzbeauftragten des Kunden, nicht als Rechtsberatung. Verantwortung im Retainer: Du betreust mehrere Kundenaccounts parallel, arbeitest in vereinbarten Stundenbudgets und flaggst Scope-Themen früh statt spät. Beratung, die verständlich bleibt: Du erklärst server-side Tagging einer Geschäftsführung so, dass sie die Investition versteht – und einem Vertriebsleiter deine Analyse so, dass er danach anders handelt. AI-native im eigenen Handwerk: Du nutzt LLMs für Analyse, Abfragen und Dokumentation – und weißt, wo AI-Output eine fachliche Prüfung braucht. Bei Analysearbeit ist das ein echter Hebel, kein Nice-to-have. Wissen weitergeben: Du coachst Kolleg:innen, arbeitest eng mit Search, Performance, MarTech und Data & BI zusammen und dokumentierst so, dass ein Setup eine Übergabe übersteht. Damit kannst Du punkten: Erfahrung mit Substanz: Mindestens 4 Jahre in Web Analytics und Tracking mit eigener V

You’ll combine technical expertise with consulting skills to develop customized solutions for complex business processes. Your mission Design and development of custom extensions, interfaces, workflows, and integrations based on C#/.NET, VBA, and XML Further development and maintenance of an Access-based business application and the underlying MS SQL Server database structures Integration and development of digital case management solutions (eIP, e2A), the Electronic Court and Administrative Mailbox (EGVP), and the integration of electronic signatures Development of pragmatic and sustainable solutions for complex business and technical requirements Consulting and technical support for clients in the digitization and optimization of business processes in the insolvency sector Technical coordination with clients and collaboration with specialized departments within the judiciary Preparation of technical documentation and ensuring proper version control using Git Your profile Several years of work experience in software development or technical consulting in a project-oriented environment In-depth knowledge of C#/.NET, MS Access, MS SQL Server, VBA, and ideally modern web technologies such as Angular, React, or Blazor Experience in analyzing business requirements as well as designing, implementing, and deploying custom software solutions, integrations, and migrations Experience working with electronic signatures and, ideally, electronic legal transactions (e.g., EGVP) or comparable regulated environments A strong understanding of business processes, as well as a passion for providing technical consulting and collaborating with clients A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to work, combined with strong communication and teamwork skills Excellent English and German language skills Application process Digital Get-to-Know-You Session During a brief conversation with our recruiters, we’ll discuss our mutual expectations. jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment

Build mechanisms for measuring impact , evaluating model performance, and driving prioritization of new data initiatives. Operate with high ownership in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment helping to define the long-term vision for our financial products. About you You are a Senior Data Scientist who cares deeply about impact and has direct experience with the kind of models that carry real financial consequence. You have deep expertise in fraud and/or underwriting. You know how to build models that balance risk and growth, and you understand the nuances of financial data. You're highly analytical and technical. You are an expert in SQL and Python.

jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description: The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project. Qualification path No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

jobs.title: Partnerships Manager

We make selling internationally as simple as selling domestically for hundreds of retailers and brands worldwide. As a Partnerships Manager, you will be instrumental in fostering and enhancing relationships with our eCommerce partners to drive sales growth and maximise revenue for the Nordics region. This role involves managing daily operations of partner accounts, ensuring seamless collaboration, and devising strategies for mutual growth and success. Your expertise in eCommerce, business development, communication and partner ecosystem development will be critical in achieving our objectives. Responsibilities: Partnership Management: Cultivate and sustain relationships with key eCommerce partners, including digital agencies, online marketplaces, payment service providers, platforms, and third-party logistics (3PL) providers. Collaborate with partners to uncover growth opportunities, align business goals, and execute joint marketing campaigns. Maintain regular communication with partners to update them on referral performance, product advancements, promotions, and other relevant developments. Monitor partner performance, analyse data, and offer recommendations to enhance sales and revenue. Business Development: Negotiate partnership agreements and contracts to ensure mutually beneficial terms. Identify and pursue new expansion opportunities, including new market entries and innovative partnership programs. Collaborate with Global-e ’s marketing team to develop high-impact promotions, events, and co-sponsorship opportunities. Create compelling presentations and collateral to showcase the benefits of partnering with Global-e . Strategic Planning: Formulate and execute strategic plans to achieve growth targets in line with business objectives. Analyse market trends and competitor activities to identify potential opportunities and challenges. Partner with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, customer success, and product development, to align strategies and drive results. Performance Analysis: Track key performance indicators (KPIs) for eCommerce partnerships, such as referrals, demos, average contract size, and total contracts. Analyse data to generate actionable insights and optimise partner performance. Prepare and present regular reports to internal stakeholders and partners, highlighting findings and recommendations. Relationship Building: Develop strong relationships with internal teams such as Marketing, Sales, and Solutions to ensure effective support for partnership activities. Serve as the primary point of contact for eCommerce partners, addressing their needs, resolving issues, and delivering exceptional service. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field, or at least 3 years of equivalent work experience. Proven track record in eCommerce partnership management or a similar commercial role, ideally within the eCommerce industry. Strong business and financial acumen, with excellent time management and organizational skills. jobs.description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. Why Kenya Kenya is where our next chapter begins. Following our acquisition of Sumac Microfinance Bank, we're preparing to go live — which means the people we hire here help build a business from its first day, not inherit one. How we execute in Kenya will shape how we approach every market we enter after it, making this one of the most consequential engineering mandates in the business right now. This is the natural extension of our mission: to drive financial inclusion, and help millions of business owners and individuals across the African continent achieve financial happiness and success. So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in Kenya. About The Role Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint , and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people. Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale. The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. Why Spain Some of our most mission-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people. So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in Spain. About The Role Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint , and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people. Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale. The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve. This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader. Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs. You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes: Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end. Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
